scenario: A PDF reader app bundles three distinct third-party ad SDKs.

supported_findings: Strings reference three distinct third-party ad SDKs (com.adnetwork.sdk, com.otherads.sdk, com.thirdads.mediation) bundled in a single app.
The permission set is limited to INTERNET and storage read, both plausibly required for a PDF reader with ad monetization.
The single logged network connection is to an ad mediation domain, consistent with the bundled SDK strings.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that multiple ad SDKs indicate malware -- ad-SDK bundling and mediation are common in free-tier utility apps and are not inherently malicious on this evidence alone.
Any claim quantifying how much ad revenue or how many ad impressions occurred.
